name: ETF decision notification

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "ETF market snapshot"
      - "ETF runtime self-healing watchdog"
      - "ETF workflow failure guard"
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_notification:
        description: "Send one safe PushPlus test notification"
        required: true
        default: "true"
  push:
    paths:
      - "events/decisions/*.json"
      - "requests/notification_test/*.json"
  schedule:
    # Technical trigger envelope: Beijing 15:20 Monday-Friday.
    # notification_center.py then checks the formal A-share trading calendar;
    # non-trading weekdays produce no close-account reminder.
    - cron: "20 7 * * 1-5"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: etf-decision-notification
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  notify:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    env:
      ETF_SYSTEM_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
      PUSHPLUS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PUSHPLUS_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Detect push notification kind
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
        id: push_kind
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD > /tmp/changed_files.txt || true
          if grep -Eq '^events/decisions/[^/]+\.json$' /tmp/changed_files.txt; then
            echo "decision=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "decision=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if grep -Eq '^requests/notification_test/[^/]+\.json$' /tmp/changed_files.txt; then
            echo "test=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "test=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          cat /tmp/changed_files.txt

      - name: Build delayed execution reconciliation
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
        run: python scripts/build_execution_reconciliation.py

      - name: Send safe notification-channel test
        id: test_notify
        if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.test_notification == 'true') || (github.event_name == 'push' && steps.push_kind.outputs.test == 'true') }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: python scripts/notification_center.py --mode channel-test

      - name: Send material user-action notification
        id: event_notify
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || (github.event_name == 'push' && steps.push_kind.outputs.decision == 'true') }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: python scripts/notification_center.py --mode event

      - name: Send conditional A-share trading-day post-close account reminder
        id: close_notify
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: python scripts/notification_center.py --mode close

      - name: Persist unified notification and execution-reconciliation state
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state
          [ -f data/state/notification_center.json ] && cp data/state/notification_center.json /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/notification_center.json || true
          [ -f data/state/execution_reconciliation.json ] && cp data/state/execution_reconciliation.json /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/execution_reconciliation.json || true
          if [ ! -f /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/notification_center.json ] && [ ! -f /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/execution_reconciliation.json ]; then
            exit 0
          fi

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          [ -f /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/notification_center.json ] && cp /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/notification_center.json data/state/notification_center.json || true
          [ -f /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/execution_reconciliation.json ] && cp /tmp/etf-notification-state/data/state/execution_reconciliation.json data/state/execution_reconciliation.json || true
          git add data/state/notification_center.json data/state/execution_reconciliation.json 2>/dev/null || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "state: record notification and execution reconciliation"
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Surface notification delivery failure without blocking trading system
        if: ${{ steps.test_notify.outcome == 'failure' || steps.event_notify.outcome == 'failure' || steps.close_notify.outcome == 'failure' }}
        run: |
          echo "User notification delivery failed; ETF market/data/trading-decision workflows remain unaffected."
          exit 1

name: ETF market snapshot

# Schedule registration marker: this workflow remains on the default branch for GitHub cron dispatch.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      node:
        description: "Data-only node label"
        required: true
        default: "scheduled"
      probe_only:
        description: "Fetch and validate without writing a valid node"
        required: true
        default: "false"
  push:
    paths:
      - "requests/live_snapshot/**.json"
      - "scripts/cloud_runner_snapshot.py"
      - "scripts/query_time_market_refresh.py"
      - "scripts/tencent_quote.py"
      - "config/market/provider_priority.json"
  schedule:
    # Explicit opening-auction pulses, followed by ten-minute pulses in active A-share windows.
    - cron: "15,20,25,30,40,50 1 * * 1-5"
    - cron: "*/10 2-3,5-6 * * 1-5"
    - cron: "0,10 7 * * 1-5"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: etf-market-snapshot-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      HITHINK_FINANCE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HITHINK_FINANCE_API_KEY }}
      ETF_SYSTEM_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
      HITHINK_RETRY_LIMIT: "2"
      HITHINK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "25"
      QUERY_TIME_REFRESH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'true' || 'false' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: Check exchange calendar and capture window
        id: session_gate
        run: python scripts/runtime_session_gate.py
      - name: Record skipped runtime health
        if: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture != 'true' && github.event_name != 'push' }}
        env:
          SESSION_MARKET_DATE: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.market_date }}
          SESSION_MARKET_PHASE: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.market_phase }}
          EVENT_SCHEDULE: ${{ github.event.schedule || '' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
          from pathlib import Path
          shanghai = timezone(timedelta(hours=8), name='Asia/Shanghai')
          now = datetime.now(shanghai).isoformat(timespec='seconds')
          health_path = Path('data/state/runtime_health.json')
          current_path = Path('data/state/CURRENT.json')
          health = json.loads(health_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if health_path.exists() else {}
          current = json.loads(current_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if current_path.exists() else {}
          health.update({
              'status': 'SKIPPED',
              'quality_status': 'SKIPPED',
              'reason': 'outside_a_share_capture_window',
              'failure_stage': 'session_gate',
              'scheduled_for': 'cron:' + os.environ.get('EVENT_SCHEDULE', '') if os.environ.get('EVENT_SCHEDULE') else ('query_time_push' if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'push' else 'workflow_dispatch'),
              'trigger_mode': 'QUERY_TIME_PUSH' if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'push' else 'SCHEDULE_OR_DISPATCH',
              'started_at': now,
              'finished_at': now,
              'workflow_run_id': os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', ''),
              'run_id': os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', ''),
              'input_commit': os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA', ''),
              'data_commit': '',
              'provider_as_of': '',
              'latest_snapshot': current.get('latest_snapshot', health.get('latest_snapshot', '')),
              'market_date': os.environ.get('SESSION_MARKET_DATE', current.get('market_date', '')),
              'market_phase': os.environ.get('SESSION_MARKET_PHASE', 'OUTSIDE_SESSION'),
          })
          health_path.write_text(json.dumps(health, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Install hithink-finance CLI
        if: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
        run: npm install --global @hithink-tech/hithink-finance-cli
      - name: Load unified provider concurrency policy
        if: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          policy = json.loads(Path("config/runtime_policy.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          key = "query_provider_max_workers" if os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "push" else "scheduled_provider_max_workers"
          value = policy.get(key)
          if not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"invalid {key}={value!r}")
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
              handle.write(f"HITHINK_MAX_WORKERS={value}\n")
          print(f"provider concurrency: {key}={value}")
      - name: Run data-only snapshot
        id: capture
        # Scheduled pulses and in-session user requests share the same producer.
        # This keeps query-time A-share facts on the canonical snapshot/CURRENT
        # path instead of maintaining a second non-persisted market-data chain.
        if: ${{ steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture == 'true' }}
        env:
          NODE_LABEL: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'live' || (github.event.inputs.node || 'scheduled') }}
          PROBE_ONLY: ${{ github.event.inputs.probe_only || 'false' }}
        run: |
          if [ "$PROBE_ONLY" = "true" ]; then
            python scripts/cloud_runner_snapshot.py --node "$NODE_LABEL" --probe-only
          else
            python scripts/cloud_runner_snapshot.py --node "$NODE_LABEL"
          fi
      - name: Normalize runtime health observability
        if: ${{ steps.capture.outcome == 'success' && steps.session_gate.outputs.should_capture == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
          from pathlib import Path
          shanghai = timezone(timedelta(hours=8), name='Asia/Shanghai')
          path = Path('data/state/runtime_health.json')
          data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          snapshot_path = Path(data.get('latest_snapshot', ''))
          snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if snapshot_path.exists() else {}
          provider_times = [row.get('as_of_beijing') for row in (snapshot.get('rows') or []) if row.get('as_of_beijing')]
          planned = snapshot.get('planned_time', '')
          market_date = snapshot.get('market_date', data.get('market_date', ''))
          data.update({
              'scheduled_for': 'query_time_push' if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'push' else (f'{market_date} {planned}' if planned else f'{market_date} {snapshot.get("node", "")}'),
              'trigger_mode': 'QUERY_TIME_PUSH' if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'push' else 'SCHEDULE_OR_DISPATCH',
              'started_at': data.get('run_started_at', ''),
              'finished_at': data.get('captured_at_beijing', datetime.now(shanghai).isoformat(timespec='seconds')),
              'run_id': os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', ''),
              'input_commit': os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA', ''),
              'data_commit': '',
              'provider_as_of': max(provider_times) if provider_times else '',
              'failure_stage': '',
          })
          path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
          PY
      - name: Verify a new valid snapshot was written
        id: snapshot_result
        if: ${{ steps.capture.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('data/state/runtime_health.json')
          written = False
          reason = 'runtime_health_missing'
          if path.exists():
              data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
              status = data.get('status', '')
              same_run = str(data.get('workflow_run_id', '')) == str(os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', ''))
              written = status in {'PASS', 'DEGRADED'} and same_run and bool(data.get('latest_snapshot'))
              reason = status or 'missing_status'
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write(f"snapshot_written={'true' if written else 'false'}\n")
              f.write(f"reason={reason}\n")
          print(json.dumps({'snapshot_written': written, 'reason': reason}, ensure_ascii=False))
          PY
      - name: Publish core snapshot and CURRENT immediately
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # Consistency is persisted by its own workflow; excluding it prevents a
          # concurrent audit write from conflicting with the market-data commit.
          git checkout -- data/state/system_consistency.json
          git add -A -- data/market/snapshots data/state
          git reset -- data/state/system_consistency.json
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            mkdir -p /tmp/etf-core-publish
            git diff --cached --name-only -z > /tmp/etf-core-files
            while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
              mkdir -p "/tmp/etf-core-publish/$(dirname "$file")"
              cp "$file" "/tmp/etf-core-publish/$file"
            done < /tmp/etf-core-files
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              git fetch origin main
              git reset --hard origin/main
              while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
                mkdir -p "$(dirname "$file")"
                cp "/tmp/etf-core-publish/$file" "$file"
              done < /tmp/etf-core-files
              git add -A -- data/market/snapshots data/state
              git reset -- data/state/system_consistency.json
              git commit -m "data: publish core market snapshot"
              if git push origin HEAD:main; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "3" ]; then exit 1; fi
            done
          fi
      - name: Quick retry failed core objects after initial publish
        id: quick_retry
        # A user request gets the first publishable PASS/DEGRADED/FAILED result
        # immediately. Slow repair remains a scheduled, post-publish activity.
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' && github.event_name != 'push' }}
        run: python scripts/cloud_runner_snapshot.py --retry-failed
      - name: Process optional broker/dashboard state sync
        id: state_sync
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          processed=false
          files=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "$GITHUB_SHA" -- 'requests/live_snapshot/*.json')
          for f in $files; do
            if python - "$f" <<'PY'
          import json, sys
          data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
          keys = ('account_fact','formal_decision','trade_event','formal_review','interaction_scenario')
          raise SystemExit(0 if any(k in data for k in keys) else 1)
          PY
            then
              python scripts/refresh_gate.py --guard-request "$f"
              python scripts/process_state_sync_request.py "$f"
              processed=true
            fi
          done
          echo "processed=$processed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Build objective intraday market delta
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_market_delta.py
      - name: Refresh overseas and Asia index context
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_overseas_context.py
      - name: Build dynamic stock context from current account
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_stock_context.py
      - name: Collect current account-stock market facts
        if: ${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_account_stock_market.py
      - name: Build E2E usability state
        if: ${{ (steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' || steps.state_sync.outputs.processed == 'true') && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_e2e_status.py

      - name: Build state context and candidates
        if: ${{ (steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' || steps.state_sync.outputs.processed == 'true') && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_state_context.py
      - name: Build on-demand query context
        if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' || steps.state_sync.outputs.processed == 'true') && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: |
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "push" ] && [ "${{ steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written }}" != "true" ]; then
            REQUEST_SYMBOLS=$(python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          files = subprocess.check_output(
              ["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"], "--", "requests/live_snapshot/"],
              text=True,
          ).splitlines()
          symbols = []
          for name in files:
              try:
                  obj = json.loads(open(name, encoding="utf-8").read())
              except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                  continue
              for value in obj.get("symbols") or []:
                  value = str(value).strip()
                  if value and value not in symbols:
                      symbols.append(value)
          print(",".join(symbols))
          PY
            )
            if [ -n "$REQUEST_SYMBOLS" ]; then
              python scripts/build_query_context.py --force-refresh --symbols "$REQUEST_SYMBOLS"
            else
              python scripts/build_query_context.py --force-refresh
            fi
          else
            python scripts/build_query_context.py
          fi
          python scripts/refresh_gate.py --annotate-contexts
      - name: Build post-market review context
        if: ${{ (steps.snapshot_result.outputs.snapshot_written == 'true' || steps.state_sync.outputs.processed == 'true') && github.event.inputs.probe_only != 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/build_post_market_review.py
      - name: Commit downstream runtime/data artifacts
        if: ${{ always() && (steps.session_gate.outcome == 'success' || steps.capture.outcome == 'success' || steps.state_sync.outputs.processed == 'true') }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # Finalize runtime health from the post-retry snapshot, not the initial capture result.
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from datetime import datetime
          from pathlib import Path
          health_path = Path('data/state/runtime_health.json')
          if os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'push':
              raise SystemExit(0)
          if health_path.exists():
              health = json.loads(health_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
              snapshot_path = Path(str(health.get('latest_snapshot') or ''))
              if snapshot_path.exists():
                  snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                  if str(snapshot.get('workflow_run_id', '')) == str(__import__('os').environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', '')):
                      quality = str(snapshot.get('quality_status') or '')
                      if quality in {'PASS', 'DEGRADED'}:
                          provider_times = [row.get('as_of_beijing') for row in (snapshot.get('rows') or []) if row.get('as_of_beijing')]
                          health['status'] = quality
                          health['quality_status'] = quality
                          health['market_date'] = snapshot.get('market_date', health.get('market_date', ''))
                          health['node'] = snapshot.get('node', health.get('node', 'live'))
                          health['market_phase'] = snapshot.get('market_phase', health.get('market_phase', ''))
                          health['captured_at'] = snapshot.get('captured_at', health.get('captured_at', ''))
                          health['captured_at_beijing'] = snapshot.get('captured_at_beijing', health.get('captured_at_beijing', ''))
                          health['provider_as_of'] = max(provider_times) if provider_times else health.get('provider_as_of', '')
                          health['count'] = snapshot.get('count', health.get('count', 0))
                          health['latest_snapshot'] = str(snapshot_path).replace('\\\\', '/')
                          health['failure_stage'] = '' if quality == 'PASS' else health.get('failure_stage', '')
                          health_path.write_text(json.dumps(health, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
          PY
          # system_consistency is owned by the dedicated audit workflow and may
          # change concurrently; keep it out of this data commit.

name: ETF opening-auction CURRENT fallback

# Reliability fallback only. The canonical market-snapshot workflow remains the
# primary A-share collector. This wrapper uses the same cloud_runner_snapshot
# producer when GitHub cron delay leaves CURRENT stale during 09:15-09:29.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "18,23,28 1 * * 1-5" # Beijing 09:18 / 09:23 / 09:28 Mon-Fri

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  # Share the primary workflow concurrency group so the fallback never races a
  # canonical market-snapshot publish.
  group: etf-market-snapshot-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  opening-auction-readiness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    env:
      HITHINK_FINANCE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HITHINK_FINANCE_API_KEY }}
      ETF_SYSTEM_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
      HITHINK_RETRY_LIMIT: "2"
      HITHINK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "25"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Decide whether opening-auction CURRENT needs repair
        id: readiness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
          from pathlib import Path

          bj = timezone(timedelta(hours=8), name='Asia/Shanghai')
          now = datetime.now(bj)
          today = now.date().isoformat()
          minute = now.hour * 60 + now.minute
          current = json.loads(Path('data/state/CURRENT.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          calendar = json.loads(Path('config/market/a_share_trading_calendar_2026.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          is_trading_day = now.weekday() < 5 and today not in set(calendar.get('closed_dates') or [])
          in_auction = 9 * 60 + 15 <= minute < 9 * 60 + 30
          captured_text = str(current.get('captured_at') or '')
          try:
              captured = datetime.fromisoformat(captured_text).astimezone(bj) if captured_text else None
          except ValueError:
              captured = None
          current_is_today_auction = (
              current.get('market_date') == today
              and (current.get('data_freshness') or {}).get('market_phase') == 'OPENING_CALL_AUCTION'
              and captured is not None
          )
          age_seconds = (now - captured).total_seconds() if current_is_today_auction else None
          # Repair when CURRENT is still on the previous market date, when it is
          # not an auction node, or when the latest auction pulse is older than
          # five minutes. This keeps 09:25 final-auction evidence available even
          # if one of the primary scheduled pulses is delayed.
          need = bool(is_trading_day and in_auction and (not current_is_today_auction or age_seconds is None or age_seconds > 300))
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write(f"need_capture={'true' if need else 'false'}\n")
              f.write(f"market_date={today}\n")
          print(json.dumps({
              'need_capture': need,
              'now_beijing': now.isoformat(timespec='seconds'),
              'current_market_date': current.get('market_date'),
              'current_node': current.get('latest_valid_node'),
              'current_market_phase': (current.get('data_freshness') or {}).get('market_phase'),
              'current_captured_at': captured_text,
              'auction_age_seconds': age_seconds,
          }, ensure_ascii=False))
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Install canonical A-share provider CLI
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        run: npm install --global @hithink-tech/hithink-finance-cli
      - name: Capture through canonical snapshot producer
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        run: python scripts/cloud_runner_snapshot.py --node scheduled
      - name: Refresh decision-facing contexts
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python scripts/build_market_delta.py
          python scripts/build_overseas_context.py
          python scripts/build_stock_context.py
          python scripts/build_account_stock_market.py
          python scripts/build_state_context.py
          python scripts/build_query_context.py
          python scripts/build_e2e_status.py
      - name: Verify same-day auction CURRENT before publish
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          current = json.loads(Path('data/state/CURRENT.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          expected = '${{ steps.readiness.outputs.market_date }}'
          phase = (current.get('data_freshness') or {}).get('market_phase')
          if current.get('market_date') != expected or phase != 'OPENING_CALL_AUCTION':
              raise SystemExit(f"opening-auction CURRENT verification failed: {current}")
          if current.get('node_status') not in {'READY', 'DEGRADED'}:
              raise SystemExit(f"opening-auction CURRENT not publishable: {current.get('node_status')}")
          print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'market_date': expected, 'phase': phase, 'snapshot': current.get('latest_snapshot')}, ensure_ascii=False))
          PY
      - name: Publish repaired CURRENT and contexts
        if: ${{ steps.readiness.outputs.need_capture == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -- data/state/system_consistency.json 2>/dev/null || true
          git add -A -- data/market/snapshots data/state
          git reset -- data/state/system_consistency.json 2>/dev/null || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p /tmp/opening-auction-fallback
          git diff --cached --name-only -z > /tmp/opening-auction-files
          while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            mkdir -p "/tmp/opening-auction-fallback/$(dirname "$file")"
            cp "$file" "/tmp/opening-auction-fallback/$file"
          done < /tmp/opening-auction-files
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
              mkdir -p "$(dirname "$file")"
              cp "/tmp/opening-auction-fallback/$file" "$file"
            done < /tmp/opening-auction-files
            git add -A -- data/market/snapshots data/state
            git reset -- data/state/system_consistency.json 2>/dev/null || true
            git commit -m "data: repair opening-auction CURRENT readiness"
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then
              break
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" = "3" ]; then exit 1; fi
          done

        id: assess
        shell: bash
        run: |

          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          data = json.loads(Path('data/state/self_healing_status.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write(f"action={data.get('recommended_action', 'NONE')}\n")
              f.write(f"classification={data.get('classification', 'UNKNOWN')}\n")
          print(f"classification={data.get('classification')} action={data.get('recommended_action')}")
          PY

      - name: Rebuild derived contexts safely
        if: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.action == 'REBUILD_DERIVED_CONTEXTS' }}
        run: |
          python scripts/build_state_context.py
          python scripts/build_query_context.py
          python scripts/runtime_self_heal.py --assess

      - name: Repair deterministic metadata drift
        if: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.action == 'SYNC_RULES_VERSION_METADATA' }}
        run: |
          python scripts/runtime_self_heal.py --repair-safe
          python scripts/build_state_context.py
          python scripts/build_query_context.py
          python scripts/runtime_self_heal.py --assess

      - name: Dispatch replacement market snapshot
        if: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.action == 'REFRESH_SNAPSHOT' }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run market-snapshot.yml --ref main -f node=scheduled -f probe_only=false
          python scripts/runtime_self_heal.py --record-trigger

      - name: Persist bounded self-healing state and deterministic repairs
        if: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.action != 'NONE' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A -- data/state/self_healing_status.json data/state/CURRENT.json data/state/query_context.json data/state/decision_context.json data/state/intraday_path_features.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "ops: record deterministic runtime self-healing"
          # Derived builders may touch other tracked state files. Keep only the
          # owned repair commit before rebasing so concurrent state commits do
          # not make git pull --rebase fail on a dirty worktree.
          git restore --worktree .
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Escalate persistent or structural failure
        if: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.action == 'ESCALATE' }}
        run: |
          echo "Self-healing stopped at the safety boundary. Manual/Codex diagnosis is required."
          cat data/state/self_healing_status.json
          exit 1

          if [ -n "$files" ]; then

            printf '%s\n' "$files" > /tmp/trade_fact_correction_requests.txt
          else
            echo "has_request=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Run requested research historical backfill
        id: backfill
        if: ${{ steps.backfill_request.outputs.has_request == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check pandas
          rc=0
          while IFS= read -r f; do
            [ -z "$f" ] && continue
            python scripts/backfill_research_daily_history.py "$f" || rc=$?
            [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && break
          done < /tmp/research_backfill_requests.txt
          exit "$rc"
      - name: Apply confirmed trade fact correction
        id: trade_fact_correction
        if: ${{ steps.trade_fact_correction_request.outputs.has_request == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc=0
          while IFS= read -r f; do

            [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && break

          rc1=$?
          python scripts/check_research_integration.py
          rc2=$?
          python scripts/check_market_state_consistency.py
          rc3=$?

            exit 1
          fi

        shell: bash
        run: |

        if: ${{ always() }}

        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          # Preserve only files owned by this validation run, then rebase the

          for f in data/state/system_consistency.json data/state/maintenance_health.json data/state/maintenance_diagnostic.json data/state/last_known_good.json data/state/e2e_status.json data/state/us_extended_hours_context.json data/state/overseas_context.json; do

            cp -r data/state/historical_backfill_status.json data/state/historical_position_research.json research/reports events/research/daily_features /tmp/etf-owned-state/backfill/ 2>/dev/null || true

          if [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction_request.outputs.has_request }}" = "true" ] && [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction.outcome }}" != "failure" ]; then

              [ -z "$f" ] && continue
              event_id=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8")).get("trade_event_id",""))' "$f")

          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          for f in data/state/system_consistency.json data/state/maintenance_health.json data/state/maintenance_diagnostic.json data/state/last_known_good.json data/state/e2e_status.json data/state/us_extended_hours_context.json data/state/overseas_context.json; do

              cp "/tmp/etf-owned-state/$f" "$f"

          done

          if [ "${{ steps.backfill_request.outputs.has_request }}" = "true" ]; then
            # Historical backfill remains owned by this workflow; existing
            # backfill persistence behavior is intentionally unchanged.
            git add data/state/historical_backfill_status.json data/state/historical_position_research.json research/reports events/research/daily_features 2>/dev/null || true
            git add -f -- data/market/audit/research_backfill 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          if [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction_request.outputs.has_request }}" = "true" ] && [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction.outcome }}" != "failure" ]; then
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/ETF当前状态_DASHBOARD.md .
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/ETF市场行情档案_2026.md .
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/ETF交易复盘与经验库_2026.md .
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/data/state/etf_strategy_equity.json data/state/
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/data/state/trade_fact_correction_receipt.json data/state/ 2>/dev/null || true
            cp /tmp/etf-owned-state/trade-correction/events/trades/*.json events/trades/ 2>/dev/null || true
            git add ETF当前状态_DASHBOARD.md ETF市场行情档案_2026.md ETF交易复盘与经验库_2026.md data/state/etf_strategy_equity.json data/state/trade_fact_correction_receipt.json events/trades 2>/dev/null || true
          fi

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction_request.outputs.has_request }}" = "true" ] && [ "${{ steps.trade_fact_correction.outcome }}" != "failure" ]; then
            msg="state: backfill confirmed trade fee facts"
          elif [ "${{ steps.backfill_request.outputs.has_request }}" = "true" ]; then
            msg="research: backfill ETF daily evidence"
          else
            msg="state: refresh consistency maintenance and e2e readiness"
          fi
          git commit -m "$msg"
          git push origin HEAD:main
      - name: Enforce research backfill result
        if: ${{ steps.backfill_request.outputs.has_request == 'true' && steps.backfill.outcome == 'failure' }}

      - name: Enforce trade fact correction result

      - name: Enforce hard consistency result
        if: ${{ steps.consistency.outcome == 'failure' }}

on:
  # Only global/US-targeted request files need the US context workflow.

  push:
    paths:

      - "requests/live_snapshot/**us*.json"
      - "requests/live_snapshot/**ndx*.json"
      - "requests/live_snapshot/**hstech*.json"
      - "requests/live_snapshot/**kospi*.json"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      symbols:
        description: "Optional comma-separated US symbols for immediate query-time refresh"
        required: false
        default: ""
  schedule:
    # US pre-market, regular session and post-market at ten-minute target.
    - cron: "*/10 8-23 * * 1-5"
    # Standard-time tail crosses UTC midnight on Tue-Sat.
    - cron: "*/10 0-1 * * 2-6"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: etf-us-extended-hours-pulse
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  us_extended:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      ETF_SYSTEM_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
      US_EXTENDED_SYMBOLS: ${{ inputs.symbols || '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Rebase pulse workspace before refresh
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git rebase origin/main
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: Refresh US extended-hours context
        run: python scripts/build_us_extended_hours_context.py
      - name: Run system consistency live audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python scripts/check_system_consistency.py
          git checkout -- data/state/system_consistency.json || true
      - name: Commit US extended-hours context
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/state/us_extended_hours_context.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: refresh US extended-hours context"
          # The audit may leave unrelated generated files dirty. They are
          # owned by their own workflows and must not block the US data push.
          git stash push --include-untracked -m "preserve non-US generated state" || true
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git stash drop || true
          git push origin HEAD:main

name: ETF workflow failure guard

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "ETF system consistency"
      - "ETF runtime self-healing watchdog"
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: etf-workflow-failure-guard
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  diagnose:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 6
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Build failure packet with failed step and recent diff
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RUN_ID='${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}'
          HEAD_SHA='${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}'
          WORKFLOW_NAME='${{ github.event.workflow_run.name }}'
          RUN_ATTEMPT='${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}'

          git fetch origin main --quiet
          MAIN_HEAD=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
          COMMIT_MESSAGE=$(git show -s --format=%s "$HEAD_SHA" 2>/dev/null || true)
          COMMIT_AUTHOR=$(git show -s --format='%an <%ae>' "$HEAD_SHA" 2>/dev/null || true)
          PARENT_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$HEAD_SHA^" 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ -n "$PARENT_SHA" ]; then
            git diff --name-only "$PARENT_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" > /tmp/changed_files.txt
          else
            : > /tmp/changed_files.txt
          fi

          gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/jobs?per_page=100" > /tmp/jobs.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          jobs_raw = json.loads(Path('/tmp/jobs.json').read_text())
          jobs = []
          for job in jobs_raw.get('jobs', []):
              jobs.append({
                  'id': job.get('id'),
                  'name': job.get('name'),
                  'conclusion': job.get('conclusion'),
                  'steps': [
                      {
                          'name': s.get('name'),
                          'number': s.get('number'),
                          'conclusion': s.get('conclusion'),
                      }
                      for s in job.get('steps', [])
                  ],
              })
          payload = {
              'workflow_name': os.environ['WORKFLOW_NAME'],
              'run_id': int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
              'run_attempt': int(os.environ['RUN_ATTEMPT']),
              'head_sha': os.environ['HEAD_SHA'],
              'main_head_sha': os.environ['MAIN_HEAD'],
              'parent_sha': os.environ.get('PARENT_SHA') or None,
              'commit_message': os.environ.get('COMMIT_MESSAGE') or None,
              'commit_author': os.environ.get('COMMIT_AUTHOR') or None,
              'changed_files': [x.strip() for x in Path('/tmp/changed_files.txt').read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()],
              'jobs': jobs,
          }
          Path('/tmp/workflow_failure_input.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
        env:
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.name }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
          MAIN_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          PARENT_SHA: ""
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: ""
          COMMIT_AUTHOR: ""

      - name: Normalize packet against live main and classify
        id: classify
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path('/tmp/workflow_failure_input.json')
          data = json.loads(p.read_text())
          def out(*args):
              r = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
              return r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode == 0 else ''
          head = data.get('head_sha') or ''
          data['main_head_sha'] = out('git', 'rev-parse', 'origin/main')
          data['parent_sha'] = out('git', 'rev-parse', f'{head}^') or None
          data['commit_message'] = out('git', 'show', '-s', '--format=%s', head) or None
          data['commit_author'] = out('git', 'show', '-s', '--format=%an <%ae>', head) or None
          if data['parent_sha']:
              changed = out('git', 'diff', '--name-only', data['parent_sha'], head)
              data['changed_files'] = [x for x in changed.splitlines() if x]
          p.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
          python scripts/workflow_failure_guard.py /tmp/workflow_failure_input.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          d = json.loads(Path('data/state/workflow_failure_diagnostic.json').read_text())
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              f.write(f"action={d.get('recommended_action', 'ESCALATE_WITH_DIAGNOSTIC')}\n")
              f.write(f"classification={d.get('classification', 'UNKNOWN')}\n")
          print(json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
          PY

      - name: Re-run transient failed jobs once
        if: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.action == 'RERUN_FAILED_JOBS_ONCE' }}
        run: |
          gh run rerun '${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}' --failed

      - name: Restricted automatic revert of maintenance-only regression
        if: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.action == 'AUTO_REVERT_HEAD_MAINTENANCE_COMMIT' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TARGET=$(python -c "import json; print(json.load(open('data/state/restricted_rollback_plan.json'))['target_sha'])")
          git fetch origin main --quiet
          LIVE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
          if [ "$TARGET" != "$LIVE_HEAD" ]; then
            echo "main advanced; automatic revert aborted"
            exit 0
          fi
          git checkout -B main origin/main
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git revert --no-edit "$TARGET"
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Persist diagnostic and rollback plan
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [ -f data/state/workflow_failure_diagnostic.json ] || exit 0
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin main --quiet
          git checkout -B guard-state origin/main
          git add -f data/state/workflow_failure_diagnostic.json data/state/restricted_rollback_plan.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "state: record workflow failure diagnosis"
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Escalation boundary
        if: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.action == 'ESCALATE_WITH_DIAGNOSTIC' }}
        run: |
          echo "Automatic maintenance stopped at the safety boundary."
          cat data/state/workflow_failure_diagnostic.json
